articles.summary: Mark Young, Vice President and Chief Accounting Officer, Named VP and Interim CFO MasterBrand, Inc. (NYSE: MBC, the “Company,” or “MasterBrand”), the largest residential cabinet manufacturer in North America, today announced the appointment of Mark Young, Vice President and Chief Accounting Officer, as Vice President and Interim Chief Financial Officer, effective immediately. He succeeds Andrea Simon, who has agreed to remain with the Company in an advisory capacity through March 31, 2027, to facilitate a seamless transition. The Company has initiated a comprehensive search process, with the assistance of a leading executive search firm, to identify a permanent CFO from internal and external candidates. articles.title: MasterBrand Announces CFO Transition

articles.summary: MasterBrand, Inc. (NYSE: MBC, the “Company,” or “MasterBrand”), the largest residential cabinet manufacturer in North America, today announced it will release its third quarter 2026 financial results after the market close on Thursday, November 5, 2026. The Company will hold a live conference call and webcast at 4:30 p.m. ET the same day to discuss the financial results and business outlook. Telephone access to the live call will be available at (888) 396-8049 (U.S.) or by dialing (416) 764-8646 (international). The live audio webcast can be accessed on the “Investors” section of the MasterBrand website at www.masterbrand.com . A telephone replay will be available approximately one hour following completion of the call through November 19, 2026. To access the replay, please dial (877) 660-6853 (U.S.) or (201) 612-7415 (international). The replay passcode is 13762811. An archived webcast of the conference call will also be available on the "Investors" page of the Company's website.
articles.title: MasterBrand to Announce Third Quarter 2026 Results on November 5
